rows.title: Technical note: Accurate, reliable, and high-resolution air quality predictions by improving the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service using a novel statistical post-processing method
rows.methods_task: Daily PM10/PM2.5; maximum 8-hour O3 and 1-hour NO2; EMOS then INLA-SPDE.
rows.evaluation_spatial: 668 training/82 stratified held-out stations; next-day repetition using previous three days.
rows.inputs_availability: CAMS available 08 UTC. Main 2.2 says ECMWF operational weather; supplement S1 lists ERA5 precipitation, wind and boundary-layer height. Receipt-time audit unresolved.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Predictive distributions, PIT, intervals and exceedance diagnostics; cohort advice not established.
rows.relation: Direct overlap with CAMS station correction and spatial uncertainty. Weather provenance discrepancy prevents treating this as proof of issue-time validity.

rows.title: Model output statistics (MOS) applied to Copernicus Atmospheric Monitoring Service (CAMS) O3 forecasts: trade-offs between continuous and categorical skill scores
rows.data_geography: Iberian domain and southwestern France; 455 stations; 2018-2019.
rows.methods_task: O3 MOS; persistence, moving averages, quantile mapping, Kalman, analogs and boosting; 1-4-day leads.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Expanding training starts January 2018; only accumulated past observations; matched complete forecast-observation pairs.
rows.inputs_availability: ECMWF HRES forecast weather primary; ERA5 sensitivity separate. Previous-day O3 reporting availability explicitly questioned and ablated.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Continuous versus hits/misses/false alarms; boosting can suppress peaks; tail weighting changes trade-offs.
rows.relation: Established station CAMS correction. Continuous improvement does not establish extreme-event warning improvement; no cohort health-benefit result.

rows.title: Calibrating the CAMS European multi-model air quality forecasts for regional air pollution monitoring
rows.methods_task: Dynamic gamma-EMOS calibration of nine CAMS members; PM10, PM2.5, O3, NO2 and CO.
rows.inputs_availability: CAMS 08 UTC; dynamic persistence uses 09 UTC observations and previous-day values; WRF forecast weather. Ingestion receipts not audited.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Gamma predictive distribution, CRPS and PIT-based reliability; no cohort advice established.
rows.relation: Direct overlap with observation/weather-conditioned correction; static calibration does not uniformly beat persistence. No India CPCB-AQI experiment.

rows.title: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service - Regional Air Quality Production System v1.0
rows.data_geography: Thousands of European observation sites; PM10, PM2.5, NO2 and O3; 96-hour forecasts.
rows.methods_task: European regional operational system; CAMS-MOS random forest uses ensemble concentrations and forecast meteorology.
rows.evaluation_spatial: MOS trains daily on previous three days. System forecasts evaluated against available stations; analyses reserve approximately one-third outside assimilation.
rows.inputs_availability: Forecast, analysis and reanalysis products differentiated. Daily MOS operational in ADS; AirGuard receipt provenance not established.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Ensemble dispersion; threshold-detection diagnostics; no India cohort guarantee.
rows.relation: Operational precedent for station correction. System description is not an isolated MOS ablation study; reanalysis diagnostic figures are not forecast comparisons.

rows.title: Performance of high resolution (400 m) PM2.5 forecast over Delhi
rows.methods_task: Daily 72-hour, 400 m WRF-Chem PM2.5 forecast with AOD/surface assimilation and fire emissions.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Operational seasonal evaluation by lead; geographic station holdout not established.
rows.inputs_availability: Near-real-time observations/fire inputs reported; exact issue/receipt audit not established.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Concentration and AQI-category detection/false alarms; Severe forecast difficulty. Calibrated intervals not established.
rows.relation: Indian operational forecasting precedent; distinct from CAMS residual correction. Evaluation-site assimilation independence requires further inspection.

rows.title: Optimized machine learning model for air quality index prediction in major cities in India
rows.methods_task: Grey-wolf feature selection and decision-tree AQI regression.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Null removal and SMOTE described; chronological/spatial isolation not established in inspected text.
rows.inputs_availability: Pollutant-to-AQI inputs described; future forecast horizon and issue cutoff not established.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Deterministic regression metrics; intervals and cohort advice not established.
rows.relation: Indian AQI ML precedent. Reported accuracy cannot establish next-day operational forecast skill or absence of leakage without a timestamp/split audit.

rows.title: Decision Support System version 1.0 (DSS v1.0) for air quality management in Delhi, India
rows.methods_task: WRF-Chem five-day PM2.5/source-apportionment/emission-scenario forecasts.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Daily leads 1-5 evaluated separately by post-monsoon/winter season; no leave-city-out experiment established.
rows.inputs_availability: IITM-GFS forecast, emission inventories, VIIRS fires, CPCB/satellite assimilation; exact receipt timestamps not audited.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Category detection, misses and false alarms; poorer/severe episodes underpredicted; source scenarios support management.
rows.relation: Indian operational advisory precedent. Source/emission scenarios do not identify an individual health benefit; distinct from calibrated CAMS station residuals.

rows.title: Estimation of surface PM2.5 over the Indo-Gangetic Basin using MERRA-2 reanalysis and machine learning
rows.data_geography: 183 CPCB stations, 2014-2023; Delhi, Kanpur, Lucknow and Patna modeling.
rows.methods_task: RF, Extra Trees, LightGBM and stacking estimate daily city-background PM2.5.
rows.evaluation_spatial: 75/25 train/test; tenfold K-fold comparison; chronological/spatial separation not established.
rows.inputs_availability: Same-day MERRA-2 aerosol and weather reanalysis; not issue-time operational forecasts.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Deterministic errors/seasonal analysis; calibrated intervals/cohort advice not established.
rows.relation: Indian measured-data correction precedent; reanalysis estimation cannot substitute the required archived CAMS forecast baseline.

rows.title: Daily scale air quality index forecasting using bidirectional recurrent neural networks: Case study of Delhi, India
rows.data_geography: Delhi; 3318 daily points; seven pollutant inputs. Dataset section ends December 2022; results/conclusion end January 2023.
rows.methods_task: Daily AQI using LSTM, Bi-LSTM, Bi-RNN and KRR.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Training/testing reported; exact chronology, tuning isolation and forecast lead not established.
rows.inputs_availability: Input pollutant measurements stated; lag/receipt cutoff validity unresolved.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Deterministic metrics; uncertainty and cohort advice not established.
rows.relation: Indian AQI forecast prior art; full methods needed before claiming comparable forecast horizons or leakage protection.

rows.title: Conformalized Quantile Regression
rows.data_geography: Synthetic and 11 generic regression benchmarks; not an air-quality study.
rows.methods_task: Quantile regression plus held-out conformal interval calibration.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Disjoint proper training/calibration; experiments 40/40/20 train/calibration/test with repeated random splits.
rows.inputs_availability: Preprocessing fitted on proper training; operational issue-time availability outside scope.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Finite-sample rank gives marginal coverage under exchangeability; adaptive interval width.
rows.relation: Established interval method. Does not automatically guarantee dependent daily, city, vulnerability-cohort or Severe-conditional coverage.

rows.authors: Angelopoulos, Bates, Fisch, Lei and Schuster
rows.title: Conformal Risk Control
rows.data_geography: Segmentation, multilabel vision, hierarchical classification and question-answering examples; no India air-quality data.
rows.methods_task: Post-process fixed models to control expected bounded monotone loss.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Separate observed calibration losses and unseen test loss; exchangeability required.
rows.inputs_availability: Predict then evaluate unseen point; operational exposure timestamps outside scope.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Expected-risk bound with finite-sample correction; not a high-probability conditional risk bound.
rows.relation: Under-warning loss can be related only after assumptions/monotonicity are justified. Daily dependence and cohort health risk remain unvalidated.

rows.title: Online conformal prediction with decaying step sizes
rows.data_geography: Australian Elec2 demand and ImageNet sequences; no air-quality experiment.
rows.methods_task: Predict-then-observe interval updates with decaying step sizes.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Time-ordered online prediction; Elec2 even/odd sequence/holdout; ImageNet sequence/holdout.
rows.inputs_availability: Base prediction uses past data; score updates after outcome arrival.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Bounded-score arbitrary-sequence long-run coverage; IID quantile convergence under stated conditions.
rows.relation: Long-run historical coverage is distinct from next-day/cohort-conditional coverage. Static split-conformal calibration does not implement this update method.

rows.title: Conformal PM2.5 Mapping Under Spatial Covariate Shift: Satellite-Reanalysis Fusion for Africa's Green Industrial Transition
rows.methods_task: Satellite/reanalysis PM2.5 mapping with LightGBM and split conformal intervals.
rows.evaluation_spatial: Five location-grouped folds; 80/20 proper train/calibration; random inner tuning described.
rows.inputs_availability: ERA5, MERRA-2 and satellite inputs; location-year standardization described; not issue-time forecasting.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Regional coverage degradation and reliability flags; no demonstrated clinical intervention benefit.
rows.relation: Relevant spatial-calibration diagnostics. Inner splits/group normalization need independent audit; stated spatial leakage resistance does not establish temporal availability.

rows.title: Personal-level actions to reduce air pollution exposure in the WHO European Region
rows.data_geography: WHO European Region; transfer to India requires local assessment.
rows.methods_task: Guidance reviewing personal exposure-reduction actions and implementation context.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Effectiveness, costs and social feasibility considered at overview level.
rows.relation: Supports reviewing feasible exposure advice, not AirGuard medical coefficients, 10%/5% policy targets or demonstrated health benefit.

rows.title: AQI Basics; Asthma and Heart Disease
rows.data_geography: United States; US AQI categories and thresholds.
rows.methods_task: Public AQI and sensitive-group guidance.
rows.evaluation_spatial: No model split or AirGuard intervention evaluation.
rows.uncertainty_warning: Pollutant/category-specific sensitive-group advice.
rows.relation: Vulnerability-aware air-quality guidance already exists. US thresholds must not replace CPCB thresholds; no individualized disease probabilities or AirGuard clinical benefits follow.

rows.title: Evaluating Graph-Centrality Context for Station-Level Correction of CAMS Air Quality Reanalysis in Lombardy from 2018 to 2021
rows.data_geography: CAMS European reanalysis vs ARPA Lombardia stations, Italy, 2018-2021
rows.methods_task: graph-centrality features with GTWR, XGBoost, random forest
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: Station-level CAMS correction exists; it uses reanalysis, not archived forecasts available at issue time.

rows.title: Correction of CAMS PM10 Reanalysis Improves AI-Based Dust Event Forecast
rows.data_geography: CAMS PM10 reanalysis vs in-situ stations; dust events
rows.methods_task: ML correction of CAMS PM10 fields with in-situ data
rows.uncertainty_warning: targets rare dust events
rows.relation: ML correction of CAMS against stations for rare events; reanalysis input, so not an issue-time forecast test.

rows.title: Operational Forecast and Daily Assessment of the Air Quality in Italy: A Copernicus-CAMS Downstream Service
rows.methods_task: CAMS-downstream national forecasting and assessment chain
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: Operational CAMS-downstream services exist; AirGuard is not the first operational CAMS-based forecaster.

rows.title: Operational bias correction for PM2.5 using the AIRPACT air quality forecast system in the Pacific Northwest
rows.methods_task: operational PM2.5 bias correction (details not read)
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: Operational station bias correction of a chemical-transport forecast is established practice.

rows.title: Assessing capability of Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service to forecast PM2.5 and PM10 hourly concentrations in a European air quality hotspot
rows.methods_task: evaluation of CAMS hourly PM forecasts
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: CAMS forecast skill against stations is routinely evaluated outside India.

rows.title: Assessment of surface ozone products from downscaled CAMS reanalysis and CAMS daily forecast using urban air quality monitoring stations in Iran
rows.methods_task: spectral decomposition of CAMS reanalysis and daily-forecast ozone
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: CAMS surface-ozone mismatch at urban stations is documented elsewhere; consistent with AirGuard's large ozone correction factors.

rows.title: Evaluation of PM2.5 Forecast using Chemical Data Assimilation in the WRF-Chem Model: A Novel Initiative Under the Ministry of Earth Sciences Air Quality Early Warning System for Delhi, India
rows.methods_task: WRF-Chem with chemical data assimilation
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.deployment: MoES Air Quality Early Warning System (operational)
rows.relation: India already has an operational national early-warning system for Delhi; AirGuard does not replace or rival it.

rows.title: Forecasting of an unusual dust event over western India by the Air Quality Early Warning System
rows.methods_task: not established
rows.uncertainty_warning: single dust event
rows.relation: Indian operational extreme-event forecasting exists for specific events.

rows.title: Evaluating machine learning models and imputation strategies for Air Quality Index forecasting in urban India
rows.methods_task: ML models and imputation for AQI forecasting
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: Indian AQI forecasting with ML is a crowded area; model choice alone is not novel.

rows.title: Spatiotemporal clustering and multivariate forecasting of air quality index across Indian cities using machine learning and deep learning models
rows.methods_task: clustering plus ML/DL forecasting
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: Multi-city Indian AQI forecasting and clustering exist.

rows.title: Integrated air quality monitoring and PM2.5 forecasting in India: a comparative study of machine learning and deep learning approaches
rows.methods_task: ML vs DL comparison
rows.uncertainty_warning: not established
rows.relation: Further Indian ML/DL comparison; whether issue-time availability was audited is not established.

rows.title: Probabilistic Deep Learning to Quantify Uncertainty in Air Quality Forecasting
rows.methods_task: probabilistic deep learning
rows.uncertainty_warning: predictive uncertainty, reliability of confidence estimates
rows.relation: Uncertainty-aware air-quality forecasting is established; severity-conditioned coverage is the narrower question.

rows.title: Application of a novel early warning system based on fuzzy time series in urban air quality forecasting in China
rows.methods_task: not established
rows.uncertainty_warning: early-warning system
rows.relation: Air-quality early-warning systems with ML forecasting are established.
